# Findings govulncheck reports that have no fix available upstream.
#
# The weekly scan compares what it finds against this list and fails only on
# something new. A job that is red every week for reasons nobody can act on is
# a job people stop reading.
#
# Remove an entry when a fixed version appears and the dependency is updated —
# the scan will then be silent about it, and loud again if it comes back.
#
# Every one of these is reached only through package initialisation: helm links
# the code in, and the portal never calls it. That is an assessment, not a
# guarantee, and it stops holding the day this starts installing charts or
# verifying their provenance.

# golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp — unmaintained by its authors, no fix planned.
# Pulled in by helm for chart provenance, which the portal does not use.
GO-2026-5932

# containerd, three findings in image decompression. Pulled in by helm for OCI
# registry work, which the portal does not do.
GO-2026-5622
GO-2026-5338
GO-2026-5064
